name: Setteth
source:
Setteth is a biophysicist, conducting research on a near microscopic organism that lives in the vacuum of space.

He can be cold, sarcastic and somewhat socially awkward. But if you're looking to win him over, asking about his research or challenging him to a game of holochess could be a good place to start.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/330388878/love-at-the-milky-way-diner/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
